topic.title: MrBeast's videos lost money in 2024 while his chocolate bar made the profit

shape.name: The advert is the show
shape.beats: hook: the famous thing everyone thinks makes the money, denied -> that famous thing loses money, a sourced figure -> the asker: so where does the money come from? -> the ordinary product on a shelf, its sales -> its profit and margin -> the turn: the famous thing is only the advert for the product -> payoff: what the whole business is worth, a question back to the viewer
shape.why: a famous creator or brand whose show is marketing and whose money comes from a plain product; fits YouTubers, sports teams, celebrity brands

title: Why the biggest channel on earth loses money on videos 🍫
description:
Does the world's biggest YouTuber really get rich from his videos? Follow the money from the videos to a chocolate bar on the shelf.
Figures from Bloomberg's report on Beast Industries' 2024 results; the characters are not advisers.
Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
